text:
Ava (People Ops): Hey folks — finalizing manager-curated nominees for our Yearly Spotlight program. Need each manager to send a short rationale (1-2 lines) + preferred gift option (pin, enamel mug, or donation credit) by EOD Tue 5/14. Spreadsheet here: https://tiny.redwood/spotlight-noms :sparkles:
Jonas: Got it. Do we need to include headcount justification or just impact bullets?
Ava (People Ops): Just impact bullets please — what the person did and one sentence on business impact. No long writeups.
Priya: Quick Q — for remote folks in EU, do we do the physical pin or a donation credit? Shipping costs are high.
Ava (People Ops): For EU remote, prefer donation credit unless manager confirms they want a physical item and covers customs. We'll add a checkbox in the sheet to flag "ship_physical_yes".
Marta: Heads up — recruiting team has 3 nominations. I'll drop them into the sheet later today.
Leo (Vendor Ops): Inventory check: we have 250 enamel pins, 80 enamel mugs, and 120 gift cards on-hand. If you need a manual count run: `INV_CHECK --pins` and I can export counts.
Jonas: Thanks Leo. For the mugs, can we brand them with the milestone year?
Leo (Vendor Ops): Yes — extra $2 per mug for year print. If managers choose that option, mark `year_print` column. Finance approval needed if we exceed budget.
Priya: Is there a cap per manager? To avoid a manager nominating a whole team.
Ava (People Ops): Yes — cap of 2 nominees per manager for this program. If you have edge cases (e.g., small teams), ping me and we'll handle exceptions.
Jonas: Confirming — I'll add the two nominees for infra by EOD.
Marta: Added ours. Left short rationales and selected donation for 2 remote hires.
Priya: Done — added both with pins.
Ava (People Ops): Perfect. Next steps: I will consolidate on Wed, send to Finance for approval Thu, then OpsBot will kick off fulfillment on Mon.
OpsBot: [system] Fulfillment workflow scheduled: review -> finance_approval -> print_request -> ship. ETA for first batch: 10 business days after Finance approval.
Ava (People Ops): One more note — for any spot award tax forms required, Finance will reach out to the nominee. If someone needs a W-8/W-9, please tell them to expect a DM.
Jonas: Cool. Reimbursement link for managers who cover customs: https://tiny.redwood/reimburse-form Thanks! :thumbsup:
Ava (People Ops): Thanks everyone — will post final roster once Finance sign-off is in. :confetti_ball:
